title: Legal Assistant - Oxford
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an organised and proactive Legal Assistant to join a well-established Private Client team in Oxford on a permanent basis.

We are seeking a motivated individual with strong administrative, organisational and communication skills to provide high-quality support to a busy team of legal professionals.

This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your legal career within a professional and supportive environment, working alongside experienced fee earners and delivering exceptional client service.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide comprehensive administrative and secretarial support to fee earners within the Private Client team.
- Manage file opening, document preparation, audio typing, correspondence, filing and archiving.
- Draft legal documents, letters and bills using appropriate templates and precedents.
- Liaise professionally with clients, solicitors, courts and other third parties.
- Assist with legal processes, case administration, court forms and online portals.
- Maintain accurate client records and update CRM systems.
- Support compliance procedures, including anti-money laundering checks, confidentiality and file management.
- Coordinate meetings, appointments and team activities.
- Assist with business development, marketing initiatives and client relationship management.
- Ensure administrative tasks are completed accurately, efficiently and within deadlines.

About You
- Previous experience as a Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or in an administrative role is desirable.
- Experience within a Private Client department would be advantageous.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and confidence using legal IT systems.
- A professional and approachable manner with a strong commitment to client service.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information.
- A proactive, flexible and collaborative approach to work.
